item: A released element's key stays fixed whatever the data. A removal or other draft-only change of a released element is allowed only when it would affect 0 records, values and relationships (workspaces running the model and their change sets); otherwise refused with its impact. allowRelation with required to a released type is refused with its impact. item: Workbook checks report new, missing or renamed columns, new lookup values, name drift and missing records before loading; a rename candidate keeps its column position and shares at least half the values.

Deleting records missing from a workbook requires a change set, excludes records named by refused rows, and refuses surviving descendants or required dependants; single-valued relationship mappings replace their old targets on the next load.
A source may skip rows without keys only when it declares a key; its binding report and dry run count skipped rows, while empty source rows and identified heading or note rows do not create records.

Laid-out workbook lists can be adjusted by header, last row and columns, unloaded or read from a chosen rectangle; column bindings follow their original letters, and three matching lists under one title can be read as a parent list with contained records.

A migration preview holds the live rows it converts while it runs, so writes to those rows wait; confirmation binds the workspace assignment and feed position, requires explicit acceptance of loss and switches data and release atomically. A migration preview can make writes to its live records wait.

Moving a change set to the workspace’s release rebases its converted content onto current live data without changing live data or its feed; conflicting authored records, relationships and mapping sets are refused before its base and pin change together. A change-set migration targets only its workspace’s current release.

Migrating a workspace to a change set’s release and publishing it is one transaction whose confirmation also binds that change set’s version and the active publication; neither half can succeed alone.

Import profiles belong to one model and are invalid in workspaces running another; installing a draft cannot overwrite another model’s profile key, and new-model drafts have no unrelated data impact. A profile belongs to one model and cannot load into another model’s workspace.

item: Release evidence awaiting reconciliation: Rule: A record named in words is found by the engine, in the database, in the context asked about. The model gives a name; the engine looks among the proper types (those the relationship reaches for "is any of", those its records can stand under for under and notUnder): the exact name, ignoring case, first; otherwise the one record whose name contains it. None, or several, is a part in notExpressed with the reason (up to five names), never a guess. A record created in a change set is found there and not live.. The model sees no record, so it cannot choose one. A wrong guess would change a list silently. /.

item: Release evidence awaiting reconciliation: Rule: An assistant reads and writes only change sets its own principal created; any other answers CHANGE_SET_NOT_FOUND. item: Release evidence awaiting reconciliation: Rule: Eleven tools, all needing Work in change sets in the workspace. Reading: my_change_sets (open ones, with state and version), read_change_set (version, release, submission state, the last decision's comment), change_set_changes (rows, kind records or relationships, paged), validate_change_set. Writing: create_change_set, add_record, change_record, set_field, add_relation, change_relation, submit_change_set. Every write names changeSetId and expectedChangeSetVersion, and a change to a row its version too. changeSetId joins find_records, read_record and describe_type (AG-D22), which then read that change set and its pinned release. A write answers with IDs and the new versions.. The scope, with what an assistant needs to know that a person sent it back and why. describe_type must read the pinned release, or a change set on another release would be filled from the wrong model. Choosing a release needs mode.

item: Release evidence awaiting reconciliation: Rule: The answer is direct, not a job (revises AP-D8 for this purpose).
